Conflict.description:
Business rule violated: `invalid_transition`, `insufficient_stock`, or `product_not_found`
(a product of the order no longer exists).

NotFound.description: Not found, or not owned by the current shop

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit reached (`rate_limited`), retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`

ValidationError.description: Invalid request body (for example, missing `reason` on cancel)

available.description: Sum of all balance entries, so'm

amount.description: Signed amount in so'm (sale > 0, commission <= 0, payout < 0)

order_id.description: The order the money belongs to; null for a payout

parent_id.description: Null for a top-level category, two levels in total

CreateProductForm.description: The fields of `CreateProductRequest` as form fields, plus the images.

photos.description: Images (jpeg, png or webp, 5 MB each). The first one is the cover.

revenue_30d.description: Sum of delivered order totals in the last 30 days (today and 29 days before), so'm

revenue_7d.description: Sum of delivered order totals in the last 7 days (today and 6 days before), so'm

today_orders.description: Orders created today in the business time zone, in any status

top_products.description: Best sellers of the last 30 days; `[]` when nothing was delivered

waiting_for_action.description: Orders the seller still has to act on, in status `new`, `accepted` or `packed`

history.description:
Every status change, oldest first. An order created by the dev endpoint starts with one row
from `null` to `new`; orders that were inserted some other way can have no rows yet.

total.description: Sum of price × quantity in so'm

reason.description: The cancel reason, null for other changes

title.description: Title snapshot taken at order time

OrderSummary.description: Order without items, used in lists

ProductPhotos.description:
URLs of the product's photos, the first one is the cover. Open them directly (no token), for example
`/api/uploads/12/3f2a9c4e8b1d4f6a9e0c7b5d2a1f8e34.webp`. `[]` when there are none.

password.description: At most 72 bytes, bcrypt ignores the rest

contact_phone.description: 7–15 digits with an optional leading +. Spaces, dashes and brackets are removed. Empty clears it.

logo_url.description: http or https URL. Empty clears it.

expected_stock.description: The stock the seller saw before editing

token.description: HS256 JWT carrying seller_id and shop_id, sent as `Authorization Bearer`

quantity_sold.description: Units in orders delivered in the last 30 days

revenue.description: Sum of price at the time of the order times quantity for those units, so'm

UpdateProductForm.description: The fields of `UpdateProductRequest` as form fields, plus the photo changes.

keep_photos.description:
Current photo URLs that stay, in the order wanted. Omit the field to keep all of them,
send it empty to remove them all.

photos.description: New images, added after the kept photos. At most 5 photos in the end.

info.description:
Seller Panel API: sellers sign up with email and password, manage their shop and products,
process orders, see their balance, and see the dashboard.

**Auth.** `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/login` returns a JWT. Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every other endpoint needs it, and a seller only ever sees
the data of their own shop.

**Conventions.**
- JSON with `snake_case` fields. Ids are integers. Money is an integer in so'm, never a float.
- Errors are `{"code": "...", "message": "..."}`, also for unknown routes (`404 not_found`)
  and wrong methods (`405 method_not_allowed`, with an `Allow` header).
- Lists take `page` and `page_size` (default 20) and return `items`, `page`, `page_size`, `total`.
  A `page_size` above 100 is lowered to 100 and a `page` below 1 becomes 1; a value that is not an integer is a 400.
- An optional value that is not set is `null` when its column can be null (for example `logo_url`),
  and `""` for text that always has a value (for example a product `description`).
- Any endpoint can answer `429 rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds): per IP at the proxy,
  per shop on protected routes, and 5 failed logins per IP and email in 15 minutes.

**Status.** Implemented: auth, shop, categories, products, stock, balance, orders, dashboard, image uploads.
`POST /dev/simulate-order` exists only when the backend runs with `APP_ENV=development` (the Docker
Compose default); otherwise it answers 404 like any unknown route.
info.title: Seller Panel API

get.description:
`available` is the sum of all balance entries (sale + commission + payout).
Commission is `COMMISSION_PERCENT` (10 by default) of each delivered order total.
A shop with no entries gets zeros. Rules are in docs/DECISIONS.md (D7).

Entries are ordered by `created_at`, then `id`, newest first. `page_size` above 100 is
lowered to 100. A `page` above 1 000 000 or a value that is not an integer is a 400.

Read only and the same for every seller. Top-level categories have `parent_id: null`.
Each parent comes before its children.
get.summary: The category tree as a flat list

get.description:
Days are calendar days in the business time zone (`BUSINESS_TIMEZONE`, `Asia/Tashkent` by default),
not in UTC. "Today" runs from 00:00 to 24:00 in that zone, "last 7 days" is today and the 6 days
before it, and "last 30 days" is today and the 29 days before it.

- `today_orders`: orders created today, in any status.
- `waiting_for_action`: orders in `new`, `accepted` or `packed`, whatever their age.
- `revenue_7d`, `revenue_30d`: sum of the `total` of orders that became `delivered` in the window,
  before commission. Cancelled orders never count.
- `top_products`: up to 5 products by units in orders delivered in the last 30 days, most units first,
  then most revenue, then lowest `product_id`. `title` is the current title of the product.

A shop with no orders gets zeros and `top_products: []`, not 404. Rules are in docs/DECISIONS.md (D10).
get.summary: Home page numbers for the current shop

post.description:
Development only, there is no buyer app, so this stands in for one. It picks 1 to 3 of the shop's
active products that have available stock, a quantity of at most 3 (and at most what is available)
for each, and a fake buyer. It does not reserve stock: accepting the order does.
Not available when `APP_ENV` is `production`: the route does not exist and the answer is 404.

Get one order with its items and status history

post.description:
Runs in one transaction: either the status and every side effect change, or nothing does.
Allowed transitions follow the status machine in docs/DOMAIN.md:
`new → accepted → packed → handed_to_courier → delivered`, and `cancelled`
from `new`, `accepted` or `packed`.
- `accepted` reserves stock (fails with 409 `insufficient_stock` if available < quantity).
- `cancelled` releases reserved stock and requires `reason`.
- `delivered` deducts stock and writes `sale` and `commission` balance entries.
Any other transition is rejected with 409 `invalid_transition`.

post.description:
A new product always starts as a `draft`; its status is changed afterwards (`status` of `PUT /products/{id}`, `POST /products/{id}/archive`).

Two request formats:
- `application/json`: the fields only, a product without photos.
- `multipart/form-data`: the same fields as form fields plus up to 5 images in the field `photos`
  (jpeg, png or webp, 5 MB each). The first image is the cover.

The product and its photos are saved together: when anything fails (a bad field, a file that is not an
image, a taken SKU) nothing is created and no file stays on the server. Images are converted to WebP
and scaled to at most 2048 px, see `POST /uploads` for the details. A request with images counts
against the same per shop limit as uploads (20 a minute by default); a JSON request does not.

201.description: The created product, `photos` has the URLs of the stored images

400.description:
Invalid field, an unknown or repeated form field, more than 5 photos, an empty file or a file that is not a
decodable image (`validation_error`); a body that is not valid JSON or multipart (`invalid_body`)

409.description: SKU already used in this shop (`sku_taken`)

413.description: A photo is larger than 5 MB (`file_too_large`)

415.description: A file is not jpeg, png or webp (`unsupported_media_type`)

503.description: Too many images are being processed (`busy`), retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`

post.summary: Create a product in the current shop, with its photos

put.description:
Does not change `stock` or `reserved`, use `PATCH /products/{id}/stock` for that.
Archived products cannot be edited.

Same two formats as `POST /products`. A JSON request never touches the photos. A `multipart/form-data`
request changes them: `keep_photos` (repeat the field) lists the current photo URLs that stay, in the order
wanted, and new images in `photos` are added after them. Without `keep_photos` every current photo stays;
an empty `keep_photos` removes them all. At most 5 photos in the end.

All or nothing: when the update fails, the old photos stay and the new files are removed. Photos that are
no longer listed are deleted from the server once the product is saved.

413.description: A photo is larger than 5 MB (`file_too_large`)

415.description: A file is not jpeg, png or webp (`unsupported_media_type`)

503.description: Too many images are being processed (`busy`), retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`

post.description: Hides it from new orders and keeps its history. Archiving an archived product returns it unchanged.

patch.description:
Rules are in docs/DECISIONS.md (D5).
- `stock` is the new absolute quantity (0–1 000 000), so a retried request gives the same result.
- `expected_stock` is the stock the seller saw; if it changed meanwhile, nothing is written (409 `stock_changed`).
- `stock` cannot go below `reserved` (409 `stock_below_reserved`); archived products are refused (409 `product_archived`).
- A product of another shop returns 404, the same as a missing one.

200.description: The product with its new stock, the same shape as every other product endpoint

example.message: stock was changed since you opened it; reload and try again

409.description: `stock_changed` (reload the product and try again), `stock_below_reserved` or `product_archived`.

Replaces all editable fields. An empty optional field clears the stored value.
The shop is taken from the token, never from the request.

post.description:
`multipart/form-data` with one image in the field `file`: jpeg, png or webp, at most 5 MB and 20 megapixels.
The type is checked from the file content, not from its name or `Content-Type`.
The image is turned upright (EXIF orientation), scaled down to at most 2048 px on the longest side,
and re-encoded as WebP, so all metadata (EXIF, GPS) is dropped. The stored name is random.
Use the returned `url` in `photos` of a product (the shop `logo_url` takes it too). Opening the `url` in a
browser needs no token: nginx serves the files straight from the uploads volume, the API does not.
Limited per shop (20 uploads a minute by default); when the server is processing many images
at once the answer is 503 `busy` with `Retry-After`.

400.description: No `file` field, empty file, a file that is not a decodable image, or more than 20 megapixels (`validation_error`); a broken multipart body (`invalid_body`)

413.description: The file is larger than 5 MB (`file_too_large`)

415.description: The request is not `multipart/form-data`, or the file is not jpeg, png or webp (`unsupported_media_type`)

503.description: Too many images are being processed (`busy`), retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`
